name: Huishang Bank Corporation Limited
summary: Huishang Bank Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides various commercial banking products and services in Anhui, Jiangsu, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Corporate Banking Business, Retail Banking Business, Treasury, and Others. The company offers current accounts, deposits, overdrafts, loans, trade related products and other credit facilities, foreign currency, and wealth management products to corporate customers, government authorities, and financial institutions.
